questions.stem: What is meant by the term carrier of a genetic condition?

options.text: A person who has two copies of the recessive allele and shows symptoms
A person who is heterozygous and carries one recessive allele without showing symptoms
A person who has two dominant alleles
A person who cannot pass the condition to their children

questions.explanation: A carrier is heterozygous for a recessive condition. They have one copy of the recessive allele but do not show symptoms because the dominant allele masks it. They can still pass the recessive allele to their children.
